spells.guide: For a short duration, your spells cost no mana and have no cooldowns, but they generate Overload. Once your Overload is full, you will be silenced.
spells.name: Arcane Overdrive

spells.guide: Summon a Sculk Centipede from the Otherside
spells.name: Summon Sculk Centipede

spells.guide: Summon a Sculk Snapper from the Otherside
spells.name: Summon Sculk Snapper

spells.guide: Summon a Shattered from the Otherside
spells.name: Summon Shattered

spells.guide: Summon a Warden from the deep depths
spells.name: Summon Warden

spells.guide: Summons a large rolling dirt block that moves forward, damaging and knocking back enemies in its path.
spells.name: Chunker

spells.guide: Creates a large amethyst cluster that pulses with geo energy, granting Geo Spell Power to the caster while inside its radius. When it resonates with Pillar of the Resounding Earth, it restores mana to the caster.
spells.name: Crystalline Conduit

spells.guide: Fires a shard of dripstone that shatters on impact, damaging the target and 50% of its damage in a small area.
spells.name: Dripstone Bolt

spells.guide: Shoots out a small boulder that explodes on contact, dealing damage to nearby enemies and applying the Erode effect.
spells.name: Eroding Boulder

spells.guide: Creates a fissure that travels forward, and erupts in a small spike that deals damage.
spells.name: Fissure

spells.guide: Summons a small geo pillar that resonates with nearby allies, releasing periodic waves energy. Standing near it grants stacking bonuses to Armor and Spell Resistance to every element. Can serve as the main resonance conductor for Pillar of the Resounding Earth.
spells.name: Geo Conductor

spells.guide: Raises two massive stone walls on opposite sides that slam together, crushing enemies caught between them. The impact funnels targets toward the center, lining them up for follow-up attacks.
spells.name: Petrivise

spells.guide: Summons a large geo pillar that sends out powerful shockwaves, damaging enemies while shredding their Armor and Spell Resistance to every element. The shockwaves resonate with nearby geo entities. Certain geo entities may trigger additional special effects when struck by a resonance shockwave.
spells.name: Pillar Of The Resounding Earth

spells.guide: Summons a large rideable boulder that rises into the air and moves forward on its own in the direction you're looking. Near the end of its duration, it'll safely drop the rider down. Rider can trigger this drop early by casting Counterspell on it.
spells.name: Seismic Surf

spells.guide: Unleashes a continuous beam of solar energy in a straight line, damaging all entities caught within. Can only be obtained by defeating Umvuthi, The Sunbird.
spells.name: Solar Beam

spells.guide: Summons Umvuthana Raptors to fight for you. Each Umvuthana Raptor spawns with 2 Umvuthana Cranes. Can only be obtained from Umvuthana Raptor.
spells.name: Solar Chorus

spells.guide: Applies an effect that calls continuous sunstrikes onto nearby enemies, damaging them and setting them on fire. Can only be obtained by defeating Umvuthi, The Sunbird.
spells.name: Solar Storm

spells.guide: Erupts multiple spikes in expanding rings around the caster, dealing damage and knocking up nearby entities.
spells.name: Tremor Spike

spells.guide: Applies an effect that deals damage to nearby enemies while sprinting and grants increased movement speed to the caster.
spells.name: Tremor Step

spells.guide: Creates a unique crying obsidian cluster that stores damage dealt to entities in its radius each 1s. If the stored damage exceeds the cluster’s capacity, or when the cluster expires, it detonates and deals the stored damage in the area.
spells.name: Weeping Cluster

spells.guide: Creates a wall of obsidian by carefully placing multiple pillars, that blocks incoming damage and acts as a shield. When the wall expires or is destroyed, it releases the stored damage in an area around it.
spells.name: Weeping Wall

spells.guide: Cloak yourself with the shadows of the abyss, granting the ability to evade any attack for a short duration of time.
spells.name: Abyssal Shroud

spells.guide: Spit an orb of acid, splashing in a radius upon impact and rending creatures hit, melting away and reducing their armor
spells.name: Acid Spit

spells.guide: Around a targeted creature, create a field of blood needles in every direction, shooting down and healing you for 25% of damage done
spells.name: Acupuncture

spells.guide: Cast to gain wings made of holy energy, acting as an elytra, for a brief period of time.
spells.name: Angel Wings

spells.guide: Around a targeted creature or block, summon a rolling wave of magical arrows from the sky.
spells.name: Arrow Volley

spells.guide: Cast to strike lightning at your feet and ascend quickly into the air, and gain reduced gravity for a short duration. The lightning bolt deals damage and knocks back creatures struck.
spells.name: Ascension

spells.guide: Conjure an orb of lightning that slowly moves forward, damaging creatures it phases through and bouncing off blocks.
spells.name: Ball Lightning

spells.guide: Around a targeted location, create a fissure into the void, manifesting a black hole that will suck in nearby creatures and slowly crush them to death
spells.name: Black Hole

spells.guide: Hold to unleash a barrage of blaze fireballs, shooting rapidly but wildly in front of you and igniting any creatures or blocks hit.
spells.name: Blaze Storm

spells.guide: Cast to target any creature, showing a glowing outline. Completing the cast will heal this creature.
spells.name: Blessing of Life

spells.guide: Target a creature to blight them, reducing their incoming healing and outgoing damage
spells.name: Blight

spells.guide: Create a ring of needles made from blood and fire them forward, skewering targets and healing you for 25% of damage done
spells.name: Blood Needles

spells.guide: Slash forward to send out a concentrated blade of blood, slicing through creatures and healing for 15% of damage done.
spells.name: Blood Slash

spells.guide: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, or directly behind any targeted creature. Gain a short duration of true invisibility upon reaching your destination.
spells.name: Blood Step

spells.guide: Quickly launch yourself forward in a haze of fire, searing creatures you pass through while in a blaze.
spells.name: Burning Dash

spells.guide: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a ring of creeper heads that falls to the ground and explodes. Any creature killed by this blast will conjure another, smaller, ring of creeper heads. This can chain multiple times.
spells.name: Chain Creeper

spells.guide: Start a chain of lightning from a targeted creature, causing waves of zapping magic to cascade to nearby creatures
spells.name: Chain Lightning

spells.guide: Imbue yourself with the power of lightning, increasing your speed and combat abilities.
spells.name: Charge

spells.guide: Pray to a divine magic to cleanse yourself and nearby allies of harmful status effects.
spells.name: Cleanse

spells.guide: Hold to slowly heal friendly creatures within a radius around you.
spells.name: Cloud of Regeneration

spells.guide: Hold to cast out a cone of cold energy, freezing creatures in its path.
spells.name: Cone of Cold

spells.guide: Cast to interrupt any targeted magical process, such as a casting creature or a magical projectile.
spells.name: Counterspell

spells.guide: Pull in a nearby creature and attack them with a bite, leeching 15% of damage done as health. If the creature is killed, you temporarily gain additional max HP. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Yorhavich.
spells.name: Devour

spells.guide: With a fervor of holy energy, swing forth your weapon, doing a melee area attack. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
spells.name: Divine Smite

spells.guide: Hold to spew a cone of dragon breath forwards. Each time a creature is hit, there is a chance to create a pool of dragon breath at their feet.
spells.name: Dragon's Breath

spells.guide: Conjure an earthquake around a targeted creature or location, causing tremors to ripple through the ground, damaging and slowing creatures in the area.
spells.name: Earthquake

spells.guide: While under the effects of the spell, non-magical attacks will leave an echo of ender energy behind, shortly thereafter exploding with an echo of the original attack's damage.
spells.name: Echoing Strikes

spells.guide: Fire rays of pure, devastating energy.
spells.name: Eldritch Blast

spells.guide: Hold to manifest a cone of electrical energy, damaging creatures in its path.
spells.name: Electrocute

spells.guide: Cast to imbue yourself with ender energy. Upon being attacked while under its effects, you will immediately teleport within a short radius and avoid taking any damage. Only a finite amount of hits can be dodged before the effect immediately wears off.
spells.name: Evasion

spells.guide: Conjure a line of evoker fangs in front of you, in classic illager fashion.
spells.name: Fang Strike

spells.guide: Conjure protective rings of evoker fangs around you, in classic illager fashion.
spells.name: Fang Ward

spells.guide: Aim an arrow made of fiery magic that will deal direct damage on impact and explode for half damage in a small radius around it. It flies straight for a duration before gravity affects it.
spells.name: Fire Arrow

spells.guide: Hold to spew a cone of fire outwards, igniting creatures and blocks in its path.
spells.name: Fire Breath

spells.guide: Manifest and throw a ball of fire, exploding and dealing massive damage on impact.
spells.name: Fireball

spells.guide: Shoot a small projectile of fire, igniting whatever it hits.
spells.name: Firebolt

spells.guide: Instantaneously conjure a firework where you look that explodes in a small radius around it.
spells.name: Firecracker

spells.guide: Emanate a swarm of violent fireflies, following a targeted creature and dealing aoe damage. If the initial target dies, the last harmed creature will be targeted.
spells.name: Firefly Swarm

spells.guide: Repeatedly cast to shoot individual small fireballs, which home towards your cursor, or the creature your cursor is targeting.
spells.name: Flaming Barrage

spells.guide: Unleash a sweeping melee attack in the form of a wreath of flames. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
spells.name: Flaming Strike

spells.guide: Upon casting, fortify every friendly creature within a radius around you, giving them temporary HP.
spells.name: Fortify

spells.guide: Teleport to where you are looking, leaving behind a shadow of ice. This shadow will take nearby aggro, and shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.
spells.name: Frost Step

spells.guide: Imbue yourself with a magical Frostbiting power, making any fully-frozen creature you kill turn into an Ice Shadow. Ice Shadows shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.
spells.name: Frostbite

spells.guide: Cascade a wave of frost magic in a radius around you, afflicting creatures with chilled. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.
spells.name: Frostwave

spells.guide: Turn your stomach into an arcane furnace, turning eaten food into mana for a duration.
spells.name: Gluttony

spells.guide: A more powerful but much slower version of heal, this spell will completely heal yourself upon being casted.
spells.name: Greater Heal

spells.guide: Fire a slow bolt of holy energy. Creatures hit will gain the Guided effect, homing nearby projectiles in towards them
spells.name: Guiding Bolt

spells.guide: Conjure a strong gust of wind, knocking back creatures in a conical shape, causing damage if they impact a wall
spells.name: Gust

spells.guide: In a radius around a targeted creature, or yourself if no creature is targeted, apply the Hastened effect, increasing movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, mana regeneration, and cast time reduction for a duration.
spells.name: Haste

spells.guide: Cast to infuse yourself with holy energy and immediately regain health.
spells.name: Heal

spells.guide: Around a targeted creature or block, place a stationary circle of holy magic that heals allies within
spells.name: Healing Circle

spells.guide: Cast to inflict yourself with Heartstop, an effect that makes you temporarily invulnerable. However, once it wears off, you take 50% of all damage accumulated while under its effects.
spells.name: Heartstop

spells.guide: Emanate a surge of fiery magic, igniting and rending creatures in a radius around you. Rended creatures have reduced armor.
spells.name: Heat Surge

spells.guide: Conjure a giant chunk of ice above a targeted creature or block. After a short delay, it will fall down and explode for area frost damage, doing additional damage to any creatures hit on the way down.
spells.name: Ice Block

spells.guide: Unleash a cascading line of ice magic, creating ice crystals that emerge from the ground. The final spike does full damage, and will emerge early if a creature within range is targeted.
spells.name: Ice Spikes

spells.guide: Encase yourself in a protective tomb of ice, providing healing while within, absorbing one hit or counterspell before breaking. Dismount to leave the tomb.
spells.name: Ice Tomb

spells.guide: Fire a piercing bolt of cold energy in the form of an icicle, freezing those it touches.
spells.name: Icicle

spells.guide: Cast to briefly grant yourself true invisibility, which hides armor and held items, but immediately wears off upon dealing damage. Mobs also lose aggro.
spells.name: Invisibility

spells.guide: Down from the heavens, summon a bolt of lightning.
spells.name: Lightning Bolt

spells.guide: Hold to charge a spear made of lightning. Release to throw it like a javelin, dealing high damage to the creature it hits.
spells.name: Lightning Lance

spells.guide: Lob the head of a creeper forward that explodes in a medium radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.
spells.name: Lob Creeper

spells.guide: Hold to charge a piercing arrow made of arcane energy. This arrow has no gravity and can travel through blocks.
spells.name: Magic Arrow

spells.guide: Shoot a bolt of concentrated arcane magic. Also a trademark of every wizard.
spells.name: Magic Missile

spells.guide: Launch a bomb made from magma, exploding on impact and leaving a field of fire where it lands
spells.name: Magma Bomb

spells.guide: The great power of oak infuses itself into your skin, granting damage reduction of any incoming damage for a duration.
spells.name: Oakskin

spells.guide: Shift your vision in between planes, gaining the ability to see creatures through solid material.
spells.name: Planar Sight

spells.guide: Cast to transport yourself into a personal pocket dimension only you can access, giving a small free range area.
spells.name: Pocket Dimension

spells.guide: Charge a powerful arrow, imbued with poison magic, that will release a poisonous cloud upon impact
spells.name: Poison Arrow

spells.guide: Spew forth a cone of poison, damaging and poisoning creatures in its reach
spells.name: Poison Spray

spells.guide: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a wave of poisonous magic that splashes down, damaging creatures hit and leaving behind a poisonous cloud
spells.name: Poison Splash

spells.guide: Creates two portals that allows players to travel back and forth between them.
spells.name: Portal

spells.guide: Cast to summon undead minions from the earth beneath you. The higher the power, the better equipment they will have.
spells.name: Raise Dead

spells.guide: Slam down your weapon to wreath a fiery shockwave in a large radius around you. Damage scales based on the held weapon.
spells.name: Raise Hell

spells.guide: Fire a beam of cold energy, dealing low damage but immediately applying freeze to the creature hit.
spells.name: Ray of Frost

spells.guide: Hold to cast a ray of necrotic energy that siphons health from creatures it hits, damaging them and healing you for 100% of damage done.
spells.name: Ray of Siphoning

spells.guide: Warps you back to your spawn location, or world spawn if there is none.
spells.name: Recall

spells.guide: Around a targeted creature, sprout magical roots than entangle them and completely prevent non-magical movement
spells.name: Root

spells.guide: Target one of your magic summons to cause them to explode, killing them instantly, and dealing large damage in the area around them. The summon's remaining health boosts the damage dealt and radius of explosion.
spells.name: Sacrifice

spells.guide: In a targeted area, erupt a scorch of fiery magic, damaging creatures in the zone and leaving a field of fire.
spells.name: Scorch

spells.guide: From where you look, erupt a mass of sculk energy in the form of wailing tentacles, damaging and blinding creatures caught in the chaos.
spells.name: Sculk Tentacles

spells.guide: Dash forward with a arcing slash of arcane energy, striking creatures in an area. Projectiles hit are deflected. Scales off held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
spells.name: Shadow Slash

spells.guide: Conjure a stationary shield of arcane energy where you look that will block projectiles and prevent creatures from passing.
spells.name: Shield

spells.guide: Coalesce a surge of electrical power, and unleash it in a devastating shockwave, blasting exposed creatures.
spells.name: Shockwave

spells.guide: In a radius around a targeted creature, apply the Slowed effect to enemies, decreasing movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, mana regeneration, and cast time for a duration.
spells.name: Slow

spells.guide: Conjure a giant snowball and throw it forward, bursting into a frosty field and Chilling creatures in a surrounding radius on impact. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.
spells.name: Snowball

spells.guide: Blast forth a sonic boom of immense power, passing through solid material and harming all creatures in its path.
spells.name: Sonic Boom

spells.guide: Conjure a spectral hammer out from where you look that will mine all connected stone-type blocks in a cube where it hits, leaving only ores and rubble behind.
spells.name: Spectral Hammer

spells.guide: Instill yourself with poisonous magic, dealing additional melee, ranged, or spell damage creatures that are poisoned
spells.name: Aspect of the Spider

spells.guide: Target a single area and continuously rain down arcane comets from above for the duration of the spell
spells.name: Starfall

spells.guide: With a magic force, stomp the ground in front of you and send a short tremor forward through the ground, damaging creatures in its path.
spells.name: Stomp

spells.guide: Apparate your Ender Chest inventory upon casting.
spells.name: Summon Ender Chest

spells.guide: Conjure a spectral steed that will follow you around and only let you ride. The horse's speed, health, and jump height scales with spell power.
spells.name: Summon Horse

spells.guide: Cast to summon a polar bear who will follow, protect, and fight for you, as well as providing a mount.
spells.name: Summon Polar Bear

spells.guide: Conjure a trio of spectral armaments to aid in battle: a brawling shortsword, a quick rapier, and a tanking claymore. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Hazentouvel.
spells.name: Summon Swords

spells.guide: Cast to conjure vexes that will follow, protect, and fight for you.
spells.name: Summon Vex

spells.guide: Funnel the power of the heavens into a beam of holy energy from above, smiting targets in an area.
spells.name: Sunbeam

spells.guide: Reach out with a spectral force and grip a creature, forcing them towards your gaze. Creatures are susceptible to kinetic damage.
spells.name: Telekinesis

spells.guide: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, leaving nothing but a cloud of ender energy behind.
spells.name: Teleport

spells.guide: Cast to throw your held item, dealing a base damage plus damage normally inflicted by the item.
spells.name: Throw

spells.guide: Cast to conjure a thunderstorm centered around yourself, which strikes nearby creatures within sight with a small bolt of lightning every 2 seconds for the spell's duration.
spells.name: Thunderstorm

spells.guide: Use magic to break a block. Held items affect drops.
spells.name: Touch Dig

spells.guide: Leap forward in a spinning voltaic attack, striking the first creature or surface you hit, and dealing a residual blast in a small area around around the impact.
spells.name: Volt Strike

spells.guide: Recast to place anchor points, which erupts into a wall of fire when the cast finishes, or when the maximum length is reached. This wall blocks projectiles and ignites creatures that pass through it.
spells.name: Wall of Fire

spells.guide: Conjure a projectile of holy energy that will float towards nearby targets and deal damage upon impact.
spells.name: Wisp

spells.guide: Launch a wither skull forward that explodes in a small radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.
spells.name: Wither Skull

spells.guide: Wololo!
spells.name: Wololo

spells.guide: Imbue yourself with thorns, acting as the Thorns enchantment to damage attackers.
spells.name: Ambush Thorns

spells.guide: Fire an arrow imbued with potent energy, triggering an explosion upon impact.
spells.name: Annihilation Arrow

spells.guide: Channel a devastating beam of energy. While firing, you are locked in place. When fired nearly parallel to the ground, it releases energy orbs spaced at equal distances along its path.
spells.name: Annihilation Beam

spells.guide: Launch a concentrated orb of destructive energy. Upon impact, it detonates violently to deal area damage and scatters multiple energy orbs into the surroundings.
spells.name: Annihilation Bomb

spells.guide: Create a gravitational well that pulls in nearby creatures. Upon completion, a colossal geyser of energy erupts, dealing massive damage.
spells.name: Annihilation Geyser

spells.guide: Imbue yourself with an unstable frequency, reducing your defense and attack by 25%. For the duration, landing a critical hit triggers a powerful explosion at the target's location.
spells.name: Annihilation Resonance

spells.guide: Stomp the ground to release a fan-shaped shockwave of green fire. The waves deal damage based on the target's maximum health.
spells.name: Annihilation Shockwave

spells.guide: Conjure a line of magical clouds in the direction you are looking. These clouds fall and deal area damage upon impact.
spells.name: Cloud Rail

spells.guide: Conjure multiple rings of magical clouds centered on your position. These clouds fall and deal area damage upon impact.
spells.name: Cloud Ring

spells.guide: Summons the spectral knights of the Collapsed Kingdom, bound by ancient duty to arise from the ashes and strike down your foes.
spells.name: Collapsed Kingdom's Legion

spells.guide: Summon a phantom of the 'Cumulonimbus' to charge forward. If locked on, the phantom will pursue its target.
spells.name: Cumulo Charge

spells.guide: Ascend into the air to unleash a high-output laser. The energy consumption leaves the caster stunned for a short duration after the beam ends.
spells.name: Energy Beam

spells.guide: Target multiple creatures to erupt bursts of fire at their feet. This spell fails if targets are too high above the ground.
spells.name: Flame Eater

spells.guide: Emit a radial burst of fire in equally spaced directions. The flames travel along the ground.
spells.name: Flame Sector

spells.guide: Dash forward wrapped in green fire. Upon colliding with a creature, you stop and deal area damage.
spells.name: Flameborn Drift

spells.guide: Conjure a pack of skeletal raptors to hunt and shred your foes. Higher spell power increases the number of raptors summoned.
spells.name: Fossilized Fury

spells.guide: Conjure a line of ice wedges in front of you, freezing any creatures they strike.
spells.name: Glacier Eruption

spells.guide: Conjure multiple expanding rings of ice centered on your position, freezing nearby creatures.
spells.name: Glacier Ringburst

spells.guide: Hurls a large red trident that explodes and scatters multiple explosions around the impact area upon hitting the ground.
spells.name: Hematite Trishula

spells.guide: Summon a row of thunderclouds in front of you that continuously strike lightning beneath them.
spells.name: Nimbus Array

spells.guide: Slam the ground to unleash a burst of toxic spores, poisoning nearby creatures in a wide area.
spells.name: Overgrown Shockwave

spells.guide: Conjure multiple expanding rings of spectral blades from the ground centered on your position. The color of the blades changes based on the spell level.
spells.name: Possessed Soul Blade

spells.guide: Manifest red wings for a short duration, allowing Elytra flight and increasing your movement speed, jump height, and step height. While active, your attacks inflict the Soul Fracture debuff on targets.
spells.name: Possessed Wings

spells.guide: Unleash multiple tornadoes in a radial burst, pulling in and immobilizing creatures in their path.
spells.name: Quad Tornado

spells.guide: Manifest an Annihilation Pursuer, a relentless hunter that tracks its target through dimensional rifts until they are destroyed.
spells.name: Release Riftwalker Predator

spells.guide: Summon multiple spectral images of the Dune Sentinel behind you to unleash a massive barrage of bombs, carpet-bombing the target area.
spells.name: Sentinel Saturation

spells.guide: Summon knights made of eternal fire to fight for you.
spells.name: Summon Flameborn Knights

spells.guide: Unleash a burst of lightning bolts that travel outwards in a fan shape, piercing through creatures in their path.
spells.name: Thunder Fanburst

spells.guide: Summon a violent vortex that pulls in nearby creatures and renders them immobile.
spells.name: Tornado

spells.guide: Summon three rows of thunderclouds in a fan shape that continuously strike lightning beneath them.
spells.name: Triple Nimbus Array

spells.guide: Hurl black chaotic fireball that explodes and splits apart. Black Fire deals minor damage based on the target's maximum health and inflicts the Death Smoke Erosion effect. ——Within the black flames glimmers a trace of white light — perhaps it is from this that the name ‘The Abyss of White Night’ was born.
spells.name: Black Fireball of Chaos

spells.guide: Condense the chaotic fire into wings of black flame, consuming Mana continually, and gaining additional Eldritch Spell Power, Spell Resist, armor toughness, and movement speed. Approaching enemies inflicts Death Smoke damage. However, this spell is only an imitation of the Abyss of White Night, and thus cannot grant true freedom of flight.
spells.name: Black Flame Wings (Fake)

spells.guide: Center yourself to create a wide field of Abyssal Swamp and Death Smoke. Enemies within suffer Death Smoke damage over time based on their maximum health (killing an enemy restores health and mana). While you stand in the swamp, you gain Abyssal Grace: prevents your next death. When Abyssal Grace triggers, the mud disperses. Only one of your mud fields can exist per dimension. The mud also dissipates 30s after you log out.
spells.name: Cradle of The Chaos

spells.guide: Raise the Crimson Moon, applying Moon Frenzy to all creatures within range: increases attack damage, attack speed, and Blood school spell power, and restores the Crimson Moon's owner's health when dealing damage.
spells.name: Crimson Moon

spells.guide: Engulf enemies in death smoke, gradually corroding them. If the corrosion becomes severe enough, the target will perish, restoring your health and mana.
spells.name: Death Smoke

spells.guide: Smash the ground with your weapon to unleash a frost shockwave in a frontal cone. Damage increases based on the weapon you wield.
spells.name: Frost Hell

spells.guide: Summon a massive iceberg above the target’s head and let it crash down. Higher spell levels summon larger icebergs.
spells.name: Glacier Fall

spells.guide: Summon the Holy Bell to suppress your foes. Entities within its range will move extremely slowly, with reduced attack power and attack speed. ——Peyro Chan hates this trick the most.
spells.name: Holy Bell

spells.guide: Shoot a holy lance that pierces through targets.
spells.name: Holy Lance

spells.guide: Call down a shower of icy comets. Stronger levels bring heavier storms. Anything unlucky enough to be pelted too often in a short time will end up frozen solid.
spells.name: Icy Comet Rain

spells.guide: Channel the power of Illush, The Abyss of Illusion, to drive the target into madness, causing it to attack nearby non-caster allies. Cannot coexist with Disillusion: Fear. Ineffective against certain creatures.
spells.name: Illusion: Be Crazy

spells.guide: Channel the power of Illush, The Abyss of Illusion, to fill the target with fear, forcing it to flee from the caster. Cannot coexist with Disillusion: Crazy. Ineffective against certain creatures.
spells.name: Illusion: Be Fear

spells.guide: Accelerate Daylight Cycle.
spells.name: Made In Heaven

spells.guide: Accelerate Daylight Cycle……And blocks nearby.
spells.name: Made In Heaven (Real)

spells.guide: Summon the divine relic 'The Mundus' (its projection). Within its radiance, chant the invocation "ad village" to be transported to the nearest village, or chant "ad sanctum" to be transported to the nearest supporting structure. Beware: this spell carries a certain degree of instability!
spells.name: (WIP) The Mundus

spells.guide: Briefly unleashes a piercing beam of holy light, dealing additional damage based on the target's missing health.
spells.name: Holy Ray of Cardinal Nero

spells.guide: For a short duration, you can unleash multiple wind blades. Standing casts a vertical slash wind blade that deals 1.5× damage, while sneaking casts a horizontal slash wind blade that can cut through trees. Wind blades will always critically strike creatures afflicted with certain negative effects, further multiplying total damage by 1.5×.
spells.name: (WIP) Tempest Edge of Ryan the Sword Saint

spells.guide: Ignite yourself with fire, temporarily losing armor but gaining powerful health regeneration. Attacks ignite targets, and killing a creature extends the effect duration — but once the flames are extinguished, the effect ends immediately.
spells.name: Sinfire Embrace

spells.guide: Summon the fanatical followers of the Gate of Truth (well, actually Blazes) to fight by your side. There is about 20% chance to summon a Senator with greater health.
spells.name: "The Gate of Truth Party"

spells.guide: Instantly lowers the surrounding temperature, creating snow and ice. Creatures close to the caster take damage based on their maximum health and are immediately frozen, while an icy fog is generated.
spells.name: The Frozen World

spells.guide: Channel the power of The Goddess of Abundance, Transforms the target creature into its baby form. If the spell level is 2 or higher, the target will no longer grow.
spells.name: Young For You

spells.guide: Summon a Magic Bonfire that grants Regeneration and Absorption while the bonfire is active.
spells.name: Create Bonfire

spells.guide: Imbue your weapon with Ice and Frost in a sweeping strike. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.
spells.name: Frost Strike

spells.guide: Channel the power of the stars, launching a projectile that can track targets.
spells.name: Glintstone Pebble

spells.guide: Cast to buff self with Hunters Mark. Deal Non-Magical damage to inflict a target with the effect, marking the target and dealing bonus damage.
spells.name: Hunters Mark

spells.guide: Summon a sweeping wave of moonlight that emits from the players armament. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage.
spells.name: Moon Slash

spells.guide: Emit a thunderous storm from your blade. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage.
spells.name: Storm Blade

spells.guide: Cast to summon a pack of loyal wolves that will follow and protect you.
spells.name: Summon Wolves

spells.guide: Call down a bolt of Lightning with your armament. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
spells.name: Thunder Strike

spells.guide: Conjure a Tidal Wave to crash down on an area, knocking back and damaging anything in its path.
spells.name: Tidal Wave

spells.guide: Conjures magic circles on the ground, expelling abyssal flames into the air.
spells.name: Abyssal Burn

spells.guide: Summons several abyssal orbs that fall from the sky and hit enemies with direct impact.
spells.name: Abyssal Orbs

spells.guide: Charges and releases a devastating explosion with high area damage.
spells.name: Apocalyptic Burst

spells.guide: Links two targets with a blessed bond that shares a portion of healing between them until the effect expires or the targets move too far apart.
spells.name: Blessed Connection

spells.guide: Applies Blessing to yourself, granting Holy Spell Power and healing received bonus.
spells.name: Blessing

spells.guide: Applies Blood Cut to yourself so your attacks deal increased blood cut damage.
spells.name: Blood Cut

spells.guide: Applies Blood Dash to yourself, granting Blood Spell Power bonus and life steal on damage dealt.
spells.name: Blood Rush

spells.guide: Four casts mark points, then the next cast links them into a blood zone that persists and damages targets inside.
spells.name: Bloodmark

spells.guide: Throws a summoned Ceraunus anchor that launches you toward the enemy.
spells.name: Ceraunus Dash

spells.guide: Throws a Ceraunus anchor that drags the enemy toward you.
spells.name: Ceraunus Grasp

spells.guide: Binds two targets with an arcane chain, preventing them from moving too far away from each other.
spells.name: Chain Connection

spells.guide: Applies Combustion to yourself, granting Fire Spell Power and Fire damage bonus for a certain period of time.
spells.name: Combustion

spells.guide: Links two targets with a cursed bond that shares a portion of damage between them until the effect expires or the targets move too far apart.
spells.name: Cursed Connection

spells.guide: Applies the Demned Demomans effect to yourself, arming an effect that makes you explode in flames.
spells.name: Damned Demoman's

spells.guide: Applies Earthbound to yourself, granting Geo and Armor bonus for a certain period of time.
spells.name: Earthbound

spells.guide: Applies Eldritch Gambit to yourself as a temporary eldritch buff.
spells.name: Eldritch Gambit

spells.guide: Inflicts Ender Corruption on yourself, granting Ender Spell Power bonus for a long period of time.
spells.name: Ender Corruption

spells.guide: Aim at the ground to summon an eruption that deals area damage.
spells.name: Eruption

spells.guide: Applies Evocation Fortitude, granting Evocation Spell Power bonus.
spells.name: Evocation Fortitude

spells.guide: Fire long-range compressed fire beams that can hit targets in front of you.
spells.name: Fire Blast

spells.guide: Summons several flame orbs that fall from the sky and hit enemies.
spells.name: Fire Orbs

spells.guide: Summons a fiery vortex at the target point that pulls nearby enemies inward and scorches them over time.
spells.name: Firestorm Vortex

spells.guide: Links you to a target with a holy bond. While the bond lasts and you remain alive, the target becomes immune to damage and every prevented hit is redirected to you.
spells.name: Guardian Connection

spells.guide: Conjures a water slash that deals damage to enemies in front. Damage gains bonus based on the sword in hand.
spells.name: Hydro Slash

spells.guide: Summons an Ignis Shield with limited health to protect you from frontal impacts.
spells.name: Ignis Shield

spells.guide: Launches a devastating incinerating slash that deals direct fire damage.
spells.name: Incinerator Slash

spells.guide: Throws a lightning ball that deals area damage.
spells.name: Lightning Ball

spells.guide: Performs a lightning cut that deals damage and electrocutes the target.
spells.name: Lightning Cut

spells.guide: Launches multiple lightning spears at nearby targets.
spells.name: Lightning Dance

spells.guide: Creates an electricity field that electrocutes the ground and deals continuous damage to enemies.
spells.name: Lightning Field

spells.guide: Cracks a lightning whip in front to deal direct damage and quickly pull the enemy toward you.
spells.name: Lightning Lash

spells.guide: Fires a long-range lightning spark.
spells.name: Lightning Spark

spells.guide: Throws a summoned lightning spear projectile that deals damage.
spells.name: Lightning Spear

spells.guide: Summons a lightning strike and electrocutes the target.
spells.name: Lightning Strike

spells.guide: Releases a swarm of electric sparks against multiple targets.
spells.name: Lightning Swarm

spells.guide: Applies Overgrowth to yourself, granting Nature Spell Power bonus and increased bow damage.
spells.name: Overgrowth

spells.guide: Applies Permafrost to yourself, granting Ice Spell Power and cold damage bonus.
spells.name: Permafrost

spells.guide: Throw an explosive pumpkin that deals impact and area damage.
spells.name: Pumpkin Bomb

spells.guide: Conjures a heavy sonic explosion that deals area damage.
spells.name: Ram Tchum

spells.guide: Releases a resonant pulse projectile that deals sonic damage.
spells.name: Resonant Pulse

spells.guide: Applies Reverberation, granting Sound Spell Power bonus for a certain period of time.
spells.name: Reverberation

spells.guide: Summons the Scylla serpent, dealing damage to targets in front of you.
spells.name: Sea Serpent

spells.guide: Fires a Scylla serpent jet from the ground, dealing damage.
spells.name: Sea Serpent Jet

spells.guide: Plays a melody that puts nearby enemies to sleep.
spells.name: Slumber Melody

spells.guide: Creates a storm aura around you that pulls in enemies and explodes at the end, knocking everyone away.
spells.name: Storm Aura

spells.guide: Applies Submerged to yourself, increasing Aqua Spell Power and Aquatic Mobility for a period of time.
spells.name: Submerge

spells.guide: Conjures a Thunder Cloud that repeatedly strikes with Rain and Lightning.
spells.name: Thunder Cloud

spells.guide: Throws a water ball projectile that deals damage on impact.
spells.name: Water Ball

spells.guide: Keeps a suspended mass of water in front of you, following your aim while you channel it.
spells.name: Water Control

spells.guide: Launches a summoned water spear projectile at the target.
spells.name: Water Spear

spells.guide: Cast to fire a devastating beam of abyssal energy in a straight line. While active, caster cannot move or look around. Can only be found by defeating The Leviathan.
spells.name: Abyssal Blast

spells.guide: Inflict an effect that lifts enemies into the air for 2.5 seconds before crushing them down to the floor, dealing percentage-based damage to their health. The damage dealt ignores any kind of damage cap.
spells.name: Aerial Collapse

spells.guide: Targets enemies and nukes them with a devastating spell that deals massive damage. Survivors are inflicted with a radiation effect, preventing incoming healing. Can only be  found from Toxic Caves ruins and by slaying Nucleepers.
spells.name: Annihilation

spells.guide: Cast to consume up to 5 nearby Soul Apex and recharges the Cursed Wraithblade, instantly switching it into its Apex-Shot mode. Requires Cursed Wraithblade to cast this spell.
spells.name: Apex Harvest

spells.guide: Fires a rapid succession of water bolts that deal damage and home in on nearby entities.
spells.name: Aqua Missiles

spells.guide: Exhale a cloud of darkening ash, damaging and blinding creatures in its reach.
spells.name: Ashen Breath

spells.guide: Reveals the pathfinder of nearby entities in a radius. Normal casting alerts the caster about nearby threats, while crouch casting helps sense loot, traps, and valuables like Arcane Debris.
spells.name: Astral Sense

spells.guide: Summon a Aptrgangr to fight by your side and unleash devastating melee attacks upon your enemies. Can only be obtained by defeating Aptrgangr.
spells.name: Axe Of The Doomed

spells.guide: Creates a lingering anti-magic field that suppresses abilities within its radius. Players caught in the zone are unable to cast spells and use items. Moving within the field inflicts small damage. Can only be obtained by defeating the Enraged Dead King.
spells.name: Blackout

spells.guide: Low-cost, short-ranged teleport in the direction you're moving. Works omni-directionally.
spells.name: Blink

spells.guide: Cast to shoot wither howitzer projectiles at your target. This spell has recasts.
spells.name: Blood Howl

spells.guide: Sprays a stream of bubbles that deals damage, slows affected entities, and applies the Wet effect.
spells.name: Bubble Spray

spells.guide: Creates Ignis flame strikes on the ground in a straight line for a duration. If the caster's health falls below 50%, the strikes transform into soul-fired flame strikes. Can only be obtained by defeating Ignis.
spells.name: Burning Judgment

spells.guide: Summons an Enraged Dead King boss to challenge you. Defeating it grants a higher chance of obtaining high-quality loot, including the exclusive spell Blackout. The Enraged Dead King can cast additional powerful spells. The high mana cost is intentional to make it only cast-able from scrolls. Can only be found in Catacombs Chests.
spells.name: Call Forth The Dead King

spells.guide: Summon magical Void Tomes to fight by your side and unleash spell attacks upon your enemies. Can be found in Void Cathedral.
spells.name: Conjure Void Tomes

spells.guide: Cast to mark targets, unleashing a barrage of coral bolts at the end of recasting. Bolts damage, pierce, and shatter into shrapnel, dealing AoE damage within a 2-block radius.
spells.name: Coral Barrage

spells.guide: On cast, summons Leviathan’s abyssal mines in a radius around the player. The mine placement is random, but they cannot go below the caster’s Y level.
spells.name: Cursed Minefield

spells.guide: Cast to summon random Draugr variants that'll protect you and fight for you.
spells.name: Cursed Revenants

spells.guide: Cast to shoot The Harbinger Laser beam in a straight line. While active, caster cannot move or look around.
spells.name: Death Laser

spells.guide: Launches a magical Axe Blade forward on the look direction piercing through entities in its path. Deals damage to all caught in its trajectory.
spells.name: Despair

spells.guide: Summons a Hullbreaker to fight and protect the caster. Can be used as an underwater mount, granting water breathing while ridden. Can only be obtained from defeating Hullbreaker.
spells.name: Echo Of The Abyss

spells.guide: Eek yourself and eek targeted entity.
spells.name: Eek

spells.guide: Cast to stun nearby entities for a short duration. Stunned enemies has a visual indicator.
spells.name: EM-Pulse

spells.guide: Conjure a friendly Ender Golem to protect and fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Ender Golem.
spells.name: Eternal Sentinel

spells.guide: Calls down a massive asteroid, smashing into the ground with incredible force. The impact devastates a large area, leaving a crater that erupts with searing heat, turning all within to ash. Only cast-able from Gauntlet Of Extinction.
spells.name: Extinction

spells.guide: Ignite a wave of fire, marking your place in time. If you fall, the flames will resurrect you at your marked spot, restoring you to the health you had when it was cast.
spells.name: Flames Reborn

spells.guide: Unleashes a aqua-infused slash projectile that deals damage and converts damage dealt into Mana for the caster. Hitting multiple entities increases the caster's Mana regeneration temporarily.
spells.name: Flood Slash

spells.guide: Imposes a damage cap on the caster, ensuring that any incoming damage exceeding the threshold is reduced to the cap. When damage surpasses the threshold, waves surge outward in all directions, dealing damage.
spells.name: Floodgate

spells.guide: Slams the ground with Galena energy, releasing a magnetic shockwave that damages enemies and converts any Scarlet or Azure Charges into corresponding Marks. Marked targets take continuous damage over 1.5s, ignoring i-frames. When the effect ends, a final magnetic burst triggers, pulling opposite-marked entities and pushing away those with the same mark. Requires Galenic Polarizer to cast this spell.
spells.name: Galena Shatter

spells.guide: Transform the Infernal Devastator into Blade Mode, slashing entities in front of you. Using an Infernal Devastator Evo 2 or higher creates a slash projectile that pulls in nearby entities with a fiery vacuum effect before bursting into flame jets. Only cast-able from Infernal Devastator.
spells.name: Gyro Slash

spells.guide: Summons Phantom Halberds in the battlefield around the caster, damaging entities caught in it. Can only be obtained by defeating Maledictus.
spells.name: Halberd Horizon

spells.guide: Conjures a loyal Clawdian to fight and protect you. Can only be obtained by defeating a Clawdian.
spells.name: Herald Of Acropolis

spells.guide: Fires a small water bolt that deals damage, slows enemies, and applies the wet effect.
spells.name: Hydroshot

spells.guide: Cast to summon a Ignited Revenant & Berserker to protect you and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Ignited Revenant and Ignited Berserker.
spells.name: Ignited Onslaught

spells.guide: Generates a powerful surge that propels the caster at high speed while using elytra or swimming underwater, granting temporary water breathing.
spells.name: Jet Steam

spells.guide: Launches projectiles at a 45° angle in front of the caster, that explodes upon impact, creating lava pools. When cast, the spell absorbs nearby lava.
spells.name: Lava Bomb

spells.guide: Grants a effect; During that any burst damage you get will be split into 4 different smaller damage and will be dealt over time giving the caster time to recover.
spells.name: Lingering Strain

spells.guide: Cast to deploy a Magnetron that will follow, protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Magnetron.
spells.name: Magnetron Deployment

spells.guide: Cast to deploy Watchers and The Prowler that will follow, protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating The Watcher and The Prowler.
spells.name: Mechanized Predators

spells.guide: Summons Ignis fireballs to rain down from the sky. If the caster's health falls below 50%, the fireballs transform into soul-fired projectiles.
spells.name: Meteor Storm

spells.guide: Cast to summon deadly swarm of Vesper.
spells.name: Nocturnal Swarm

spells.guide: Cast to inflict Nullflare Ice on enemies, or Crouch Cast to inflict Nullflare Fire; when Ice meets Fire, or vice versa, it triggers a Nullflare Blast, dealing damage. Additional effect stacks increase the Blast damage.
spells.name: Nullflare

spells.guide: Shoots Abyssal Orbs in a circular pattern around the caster. These orbs home in on the nearest enemy, relentlessly tracking and damaging them. Crouch cast to spread orbs across multiple random targets.
spells.name: Orbital Void

spells.guide: Causes water to erupt from the ground that spreads into a wide pool. The pool continuously applies Aqua Spell Power scaling Wet effect to anything inside it. The Wet effect grows stronger over the spell’s duration, reaching its maximum intensity as the spell ends.
spells.name: Overflow

spells.guide: Summon Vallumraptors and Tremorsaurus to fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Vallumraptors and Tremorsaurus.
spells.name: Primal Pack

spells.guide: Summon a Atlatitan that will follow you around, let you ride. Also protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Luxtructosaurus.
spells.name: Primordial Steed

spells.guide: Select multiple targets on cast. On recast end, fires small projectiles that confuse targets on hit, making them prioritize attacking nearby non-player entities.
spells.name: Psychic Bolt

spells.guide: Calls down a rainstorm that grants immunity to negative effects for the caster and applies the Wet effect to everyone within.
spells.name: Rainfall

spells.guide: Continuously shoots Harbinger's pew-pew laser to targeted entities.
spells.name: Rapid Laser

spells.guide: Reverses any incoming damage with increased power. Additionally, it can copy incoming projectiles.
spells.name: Reversal

spells.guide: Summons a cascade of Storm Serpents that strike down in a straight line one after another, dealing damage and applying Wet effect. Damage ignores i-frames. Can only be obtained by defeating Scylla.
spells.name: Serpentide

spells.guide: Inflicts nearby enemies with the abyssal curse effect and infuses your weapon with the same curse. Dealing damage to an enemy during the effect has a chance to spread the effect to nearby enemies.
spells.name: Shadowed Miasma

spells.guide: Summons a Dragon Spirit that flies forward, passing through blocks and damaging enemies it hits. It leaves behind a Stellar Trail that deals damage over time to nearby enemies. Dragon damage ignores I-Frames. Requires Stellothorn to cast this spell.
spells.name: Shear Of The Stars

spells.guide: Calls down a phantom Trident Of Eternal Maelstrom from the sky, dealing impact damage in an area. The trident remains, pulsing for 50% of the impact damage at intervals and inflicting Tidal Torment, causing thrown Trident Of Eternal Maelstrom to explode in an area and slowing affected enemies. Requires Trident Of The Eternal Maelstrom to cast this spell.
spells.name: Skypiercer

spells.guide: After activation, the caster has 3 seconds. During this time, they can teleport to any entity they are looking at, even through walls. Any entities within the teleportation range will be revealed to the caster.
spells.name: Spectral Blink

spells.guide: Summons Ancient Desert Stele in a radius, crashing down and dealing damage.
spells.name: Stele Cascade

spells.guide: Conjure a Gum Worm that will follow you around, let you ride. Also protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Gum Worm.
spells.name: Sticky Steed Summon

spells.guide: Summon Koboletons and Wadjet to fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Koboletons and Wadjet.
spells.name: Desert Dwellers

spells.guide: Summon a collapsing star that builds in intensity over time. After a short delay, it erupts in a massive explosion, dealing heavy damage and gives birth to a supermassive black hole. The black hole pulls in nearby entities and continues to deal damage within its radius. Requires Wand of Final Light to cast this spell.
spells.name: Supernova

spells.guide: Summon kobolediator to fight by your side and unleash devastating melee attacks upon your enemies. Can only be obtained by defeating Kobolediator.
spells.name: Sword Of The Ancients'

spells.guide: Summon Forsaken, a powerful, rideable creature that fight alongside you. However, beware: its will is not fully tameable, and its ferocity may prove unpredictable. Can only be obtained by defeating Forsaken.
spells.name: The Forgotten Beast

spells.guide: After a 3s charge, conjures a raging tempest that rains down water spears, dealing damage and applying Wet effect. Each hit has a 50% chance to either increase the Wet amplifier (up to 10x) or extend its duration by 2s. Can only be obtained by defeating Scylla.
spells.name: The Howling Tempest

spells.guide: Pulls a targeted entity toward the caster, striking them with force to deal damage while applying a Stun and the Wet effect.
spells.name: Tidal Grasp

spells.guide: Call forth an unstoppable tide that surges forward, slamming into enemies, dealing damage, sweeping them away, and applying wet effect.
spells.name: Tsunami

spells.guide: Cast to connect with your nearest summon. Damage dealt by the summon heals you, and your damage heals the summon in return. If you die while tethered, the linked summon is sacrificed to restore you with 8hp
spells.name: Vigor Siphon

spells.guide: Continuously pulsate sound blast to Shred Armor, Damage Nearby enemies and Applying Chilled effect. 2% of damage deal converted into lifesteal.
spells.name: Paralyzing Skreech

spells.guide: Shoots Void Howitzer Projectiles that explode and summon void runes in a radius. This spell can be recast.
spells.name: Void Eruption

spells.guide: Conjures a massive water vortex that pulls entities toward its center, slowing them and applying Wet effect. The vortex periodically discharges Boltstrikes to devastate those within it's radius.
spells.name: Vortex Of The Deep

spells.guide: Create a Void Vortex, pulling enemies in. Teleport into it and unleash a crushing uppercut, dealing damage and sending foes flying upward.
spells.name: Vortex Uppercut
